fact: The ministry says the national digital data centre (Centre National des Données Numériques), still being built under the PMICE project with Chinese partners, will give state and private institutions a secure setting to process and store their digital data.
system: Centre National des Données Numériques (Data Center)

fact: ADETIC says the national data centre is to be security-audited and certified by TECHSO-GROUP before official operation, as the secure host for public data and the state's digital services.

Ecofin reports Chadian authorities say the PMICE forms part of a broader digital sovereignty strategy, with state control over fibre-optic networks and data storage capacity as a key lever, and that Phase I, including a National Data Center, was provisionally accepted on 2025-12-20.
The minister said Chad's draft national data governance strategy aims at a sovereign national data system in which the state knows where strategic data is hosted and who manages it.
system: Stratégie Nationale de Gouvernance des Données
